# inid.me — Smart AR Business Card & Offline vCard Platform
> Documentation and Machine-Readable Spec for LLMs & AI Agents.
> Based on Gravatar llms.txt standard: https://docs.gravatar.com/guides/llms-txt/

## About inid.me
inid.me is a high-performance, 100% static, client-side digital identity and smart business card platform hosted on GitHub Pages. It bridges physical offline networking and immersive WebXR/AR experiences.

### Key Capabilities
- **Hybrid Offline/Online vCard 3.0**: Encodes contact information in compact vCard 3.0 format (<480 bytes) optimized for instant offline camera scanning and NTAG215 NFC chips.
- **2-Sided 3D AR Experience**: Front side features personal profile, phone, email, and social networks; back side showcases company logo, website, address, and tagline.
- **WebXR & Quick Look**: Interactive CSS 3D card on the web, with native 1-tap activation of Apple AR Quick Look (.usdz) and Android Scene Viewer (.glb).
- **Internationalization (i18n)**: Out-of-the-box static support for 27 languages including English, Vietnamese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

## URL Structure
- Profile: `https://inid.me/#data=<base64-compressed-profile>`
- CMS Editor: `https://inid.me/edit/`
- Spec: `https://inid.me/llms.txt`
